text:
anya.finance: Heads up — customer WellCare flagged an overcharge on private deployment invoice INV-2026-0952. Looks like platform fee and license both appeared twice. Can someone grab metering export?

tom.revops: I can pull the export. Any recent contract changes?

dave.am: They migrated to new private contract 2026-02-20 and support upgraded same day. SEs confirmed a 5-day validation window that was meant to be complimentary.

anya.finance: Invoice lines pasted:
```
INV-2026-0952:
 - LICENSE-WC-01 qty 1 $15000
 - PLATFORM-WC-01 qty 1 $15000
 - SUPPORT-PREM-WC qty 1 $4200
 - PLATFORM-WC-01 qty 1 $15000 (duplicate)
```

rachel.billing: Metering export uploaded: /billing/exports/2026-03/wellcare_20260314.csv by metering-bot at 2026-03-14T08:45Z

metering-bot: [system] export available

rachel.billing: I checked CSV — two active commits overlap 2026-02-20 -> 2026-03-19. Both emitted platform_fee prorata lines. Looks like migration didn't retire old SKU.

tom.revops: I'll file ENG-4199 for migration script bug and add a unit test to prevent emitting two platform_fee SKUs for same customer-day.

dave.am: Customer is holding payment. We promised complimentary 5 days 2026-02-20 -> 2026-02-24. Need quick corrected invoice + credit.

anya.finance: Rachel, can you compute pro-rate and issue credit memo? Tom, please include an account note and ETA for fix.

rachel.billing: Platform fee $15,000 annual -> daily = 41.0959. Duplicate overlap charged 28 days -> $1,150.69. Complimentary 5-day credit -> $205.48. Support proration small (5-day credit on $4,200 -> $57.53). Total credit = $1,413.70. Drafting CREDIT-2026-0472 and corrected INV-2026-0952A now.

tom.revops: ENG-4199 created. Patch in review. Will run canary for 24h.

dave.am: Sent internal sign-off email from SEs; forwarding to billing now. Customer replied: "Thanks — will pay after correction."

anya.finance: Approved. Rachel, push corrected invoice to portal, apply credit, and close the billing hold. Mark account note stating migration overlap and that engineering patch merged.

rachel.billing: Done — INV-2026-0952A issued, CREDIT-2026-0472 applied, portal updated 2026-03-14T16:10Z.

anya.finance: Great. We'll sweep other recent migrations next week to be safe.
